files.description: Weekly unit sales (144 rows): region (north, south or west), channel (online, store or kiosk; the west region has no kiosk, so that pair never occurs), week (week number 1-18), units (whole number; about 2% empty).

task_text: Make a table of total units for every combination of region (north, south, west) and channel (online, store, kiosk), including combinations that never occur in the data, which have a total of 0. Missing unit figures are ignored. Treat region and channel as categories with these fixed values. `result` should be a table indexed by region and channel with one column units.
intended_computation: Sum units per (region, channel) over all 9 combinations of the fixed values; west-kiosk never occurs and gets 0; missing units are skipped.

predicted_direction.reason: on 2.x the applied sum gives a missing value for the never-occurring combination; 3.x gives 0 as asked

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
